caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed goblet rendered in shades of turquoise and green. The goblet has a rounded bowl with diagonal hatching to suggest transparency and curvature, a short stem with a decorative ring at the base, and a wide, circular foot, all shown in the same greenish hue. The background is plain and an off-white color, allowing the goblet to stand out clearly. Near the base of the goblet, slightly to the right, the signature “V. Vance” is visible in small, gray text. There are no other objects, decorations, or elements present in the composition.
title: Glass
